_comment: Copy this file to metadata-instances.json and replace the values as described. The real file is excluded by .gitignore; never commit it. api_key is the bearer token of the wamf kernel gateway, obtained from the kernel side. proxy_endpoint is optional and only affects the client connection address shown in the UI; in the local open-source deploy where core and proxy run separately, set the proxy's external address (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8096); omit it online/internally where the gateway sits behind the proxy.

instances.name: E2E automated tests only (can be wiped any time)
